rv.q: Bailey also reminds us that this is a fiction, with house lights remaining up for a beat at the start of each half and actors occasionally stepping in and out of the dramatic frame.
Troy respects Bono because he sees a better (at least a happier) version of himself in his lifelong friend - he doesn't respect anyone else.

He’s had this before: a talented baseball player, he was unable to make it to Major League Baseball because of the colour of his skin. He dutifully passes his pay packet to his wife, Rose (Madeline Appiah). Fearon brings intense physicality to Troy.
